entries.review_scope: Sixteen healthy women, mean age 21.4 years, range 19-23; one participant left-handed. One repeated-measures experiment, not four independent pre/post studies. Two consecutive blocks, each pre-IMS AT assessment, two-minute IMS, post-IMS AT assessment, questionnaire. Different confederate for each block. IMS order and confederate identity counterbalanced across participants. Author-accepted version is explicitly labelled in repository metadata and manuscript p. 1. Final-published Methods comparison remains pending.

auditory_stimulus.value: Pink noise at 44.1 kHz, duration 3.000 s. Two identical samples crossfaded across near/far loudspeakers; near level rises, far level falls to silence. Ear-position measurement reports 55-70 dB SPL and an exponentially rising acoustic intensity. Exact digital envelope, source samples and calibration transfer are unavailable; this does not establish a linear-dB or HRTF renderer.

stimulus_identity_or_asset.value: White noise with looming/receding motion.

renderer_apparatus.value: Two arrays of 8 JBL Control 1 Pro speakers, M-Audio Fast Track Ultra 8R; algorithm cited to Serino 2014.

source_recipe_or_asset_provenance.value: No original waveform/seed/sample rate/full render recipe.

level_envelope_calibration.value: 50 dB constant loudness reported; measurement anchor/transfer not specified.

trajectory_kinematics.value: Simulated source travels 0–2 m before chest at 0.75 m/s, frontal looming/receding. Two horizontal arrays±50 cm, 2 m long at chest height; participant remains in place while treadmill runs 0.70 m/s. Duration 8/3 s is derived, not 2.22 s.
trajectory_kinematics.page_or_section: Author-hosted article-in-press PDFpp 3–5, Methods 2.1–2.4 andFigures 1–3; finalpaginatedversion comparison pending

motion_mode.value: Bidirectional simulated frontal approach/recede.

coordinate_frame_body_anchor.value: Chest; same height as audio arrays; center between arrays.

geometry.value: Path from 2 m ahead to chest or reverse; arrays 50 cm each side.

timing_constraint.value: 2 m/(0.75 m/s)=8/3 s nominal sound path duration.

attenuation_law.value: Source reports constant 50 dB loudness rather than distance gain.

trajectory_kinematics.derivation_note: Travel duration=path length/speed=2/0.75 s. T 5=2.22 s is last touch probe, not full travel duration.
trajectory_kinematics.evidence_note: PDFp 3 printsD 2=0.66 cm, D 5=1.66 cm; Figure 3 labels 66/166 cm andkinematicscorroborate intendedcentimetres. Preserve typo ratherthanquoteasphysicalscale.

trial_sequence.value: Sound starts at trial onset; touch at selected positive SOA, or sound with no catch target, or silent tactile-only at T 1/T 5. Direction/distance and baseline/catches random; full trial suffix or response padding not explicit.
trial_sequence.page_or_section: Author-hosted article-in-press PDFpp 3–5, Methods 2.1–2.4 andFigures 1–3; finalpaginatedversion comparison pending

trial_families.value: Bimodal targets, tactile-only baseline, auditory-only catch.

ordered_elements_and_source_selection.value: Looming/receding sound from trial onset, delayed touch; silent baseline retains nominal trial clock.

condition_intermixing.value: Direction/distance randomized trialwise; baseline/catch included.

within_trial_timing_or_placement.value: Exact trial end/suffix/response wait not specified.

task_response.value: Right-thumb button press on wireless XBOX 360 controller whenever 100 ms chest vibration occurs; ignore sound, withhold on catches; RT anchored to touch. Numeric deadline/latency correction absent.
task_response.page_or_section: Author-hosted article-in-press PDFpp 3–5, Methods 2.1–2.4 andFigures 1–3; finalpaginatedversion comparison pending

target_and_nontarget_rule.value: Respond to touch only; catch sound has no target.

response_mode_or_device.value: Right-hand XBOX 360 controller, reported 215 Hz sampling.

response_mapping_or_expected_action.value: Right-thumb button press.

response_window_and_anchor.value: Tactile RT anchor reported; numeric response window not reported.

jitter_iti_policy.value: Inter-stimulus interval randomized 1–1.5 s; exact interval anchor and distribution family not specified. Do not upgrade to verified uniform distribution.
jitter_iti_policy.page_or_section: Author-hosted article-in-press PDFpp 3–5, Methods 2.1–2.4 andFigures 1–3; finalpaginatedversion comparison pending

policy_type.value: Randomized range, distribution unspecified.

timing_scope_and_anchor.value: Called inter-stimulus interval; onset/offset anchor unreported.

distribution.value: Uniformity or sampling step not reported.

soa_schedule.value: +440,+880,+1330,+1770,+2220 ms from sound onset; receding T 1→T 5 maps D 1 near→D 5 far, looming reverses.
soa_schedule.page_or_section: Author-hosted article-in-press PDFpp 3–5, Methods 2.1–2.4 andFigures 1–3; finalpaginatedversion comparison pending

reference_event_and_sign.value: Positive touch delay after sound onset, which coincides with trial onset.

direction_specific_pairing.value: Receding T 1→D 1 through T 5→D 5; looming T 1→D 5 through T 5→D 1.

tactile_target.value: Chest vibration 100 ms via Precision MicroDrives 312-101; nominal 150 Hz/3 V/60 mA/9000 rpm/5 g motor listed. Exact physical cue envelope and subject-level calibration/trigger latency not reported.
tactile_target.page_or_section: Author-hosted article-in-press PDFpp 3–5, Methods 2.1–2.4 andFigures 1–3; finalpaginatedversion comparison pending

modality.value: Vibrotactile motor.

body_site_and_side.value: Chest, vertical placement adjusted to speaker height.

waveform_and_duration.value: 100 ms motor activation; electrical/acoustic envelope not specified.

frequency_or_amplitude.value: Nominal 150 Hz device frequency listed.

intensity_or_calibration.value: No individual amplitude/equivalence calibration reported.

external_trigger.value: Motor/controller latency calibration absent.

baseline_trial_contract.value: Silenttactile-only baseline at 440 and 2220 ms from trial onset. Reported factorial formula crosses 2 nominal direction labels×2 locomotion states×2 timings×16 reps=128 total baseline rows.
baseline_trial_contract.page_or_section: Author-hosted article-in-press PDFpp 3–5, Methods 2.1–2.4 andFigures 1–3; finalpaginatedversion comparison pending

family_or_explicit_none.value: tactile_only_soa_matched

timing_and_anchor.value: T 1=.44 s, T 5=2.22 s from trial onset; no sound.

allocation_rule.value: 2 locomotion×2 nominal direction×2 baselines×16.

crossing_rule.value: Formula explicitly retains 2 direction labels even when audio absent.

resolved_trial_count.value: 128 total, 64 per locomotion condition.

baseline_trial_contract.derivation_note: 2×2×2×16=128; source analysis fastest baseline subtraction is separate from trial generation.

catch_trial_contract.value: Auditory-only looming/recedingcatch; withhold. Formula 2 locomotion×2 directions×1 catch×16=64 catch per participant.
catch_trial_contract.page_or_section: Author-hosted article-in-press PDFpp 3–5, Methods 2.1–2.4 andFigures 1–3; finalpaginatedversion comparison pending

family_or_explicit_none.value: auditory_only_withhold

target_role_and_expected_action.value: No touch; withhold response.

allocation_rule.value: 1 catch cell×16 per direction/locomotion.

resolved_trial_count.value: 64 total; 32 per locomotion condition.

repetition_allocation.value: 16 repetitions per cell; 2 locomotion×2 directions×(5 SOAs+2 baselines+1 catch)×16=512 per participant.320 bimodal targets+128 baselines+64 catches.
repetition_allocation.page_or_section: Author-hosted article-in-press PDFpp 3–5, Methods 2.1–2.4 andFigures 1–3; finalpaginatedversion comparison pending

factor_dimensions.value: 2 locomotion×2 sound directions×8 family/timing cells.

repetitions_or_exact_counts.value: 16 repetitions and 512 total explicit.

exceptions_or_overrides.value: Baselines/catch are cells in the printed formula, not percentage additions.

block_order_contract.value: Standing/walking are blocked and counterbalanced. Sounds/distances and control trials randomized within locomotion condition. Exact physical subblock count not given; 8 toolkit blocks are packaging, not source fact.
block_order_contract.page_or_section: Author-hosted article-in-press PDFpp 3–5, Methods 2.1–2.4 andFigures 1–3; finalpaginatedversion comparison pending

block_composition.value: Locomotion state blocked, each with both directions and all families.

within_block_randomization.value: Direction/distance and controls randomized.

block_order_or_counterbalancing.value: Standing/walking order counterbalanced.

pool_repeat_or_distribution.value: 512/2=256 rows per locomotion condition.

block_count.value: Two ordered condition groups known; exact subblock count not reported.

sequence_constraints.value: No additional run-length or ordering constraint reported.

block_order_contract.derivation_note: Equal factorial crossing gives 256 per locomotion condition.
block_order_contract.evidence_note: Experiment 2 n 18 new, none overlapExp 1; optic flow 40 dots/m², approximately 78 cm/s, ispresentinboth Standing/Walkingconditions. Notanotherwithin participantoptic flowfactor.
